# steps

Modularized graph traversal step implementations providing registry-enabled wrappers around base step classes. Centralizes step registration via `StepRegistry`, enables JSON-serializable query pipelines, and organizes steps into 8 semantic categories (fetch, traversal, filter, transform, aggregate, mutation, control, setops) for dynamic instantiation and AST conversion.

## Contents

### Core Infrastructure

**[StepRegistry.ts](./StepRegistry.ts)** — Type-safe central registry replicating `FunctionRegistry` pattern. Exports `StepCategory` union (`"fetch" | "traversal" | "filter" | "transform" | "aggregate" | "mutation" | "control" | "setops" | "other"`), `StepConstructor<TConfig>` interface, `StepDefinition<TConfig>`, `StepRegistry` class with `#steps: Map<string, StepDefinition>`, and global `stepRegistry` singleton. Methods: `register` (throws `'Step "${def.name}" is already registered'` on duplicate), `get`, `has`, `create` (throws `"Unknown step: ${name}"`), `fromJSON` (expects `[name, config, steps?]` tuple), `stepNames`, `stepsInCategory`, `categories`.

**[index.ts](./index.ts)** — Barrel export aggregating base classes from `Steps.js`, registry symbols from `StepRegistry.js`, and categorized step modules from 8 subdirectories. Exports `Step`, `ContainerStep`, `Traverser`, `createTraverser`, `stringifySteps`, `StepConfig`, `StepTokenColorizers` (base); `StepRegistry`, `stepRegistry`, `isKnownStep`, `createStepFromJSON`, `StepConstructor`, `StepDefinition`, `StepCategory`, `ASTConversionContext` (registry); plus fetch, traversal, filter, aggregate, mutation, control, setops, and transform step classes.

### Deprecated Re-exports

**[base.ts](./base.ts)** — Transitional re-export of `Step`, `ContainerStep`, `Traverser`, `createTraverser`, `stringifySteps`, `StepConfig`, `StepTokenColorizers` from `../Steps.js`. Definitions remain in source file.

## Subdirectories

### [aggregate/](./aggregate/)

Registry wrappers for aggregation operations. Exports `CountStep`, `SumStep`, `AvgStep`, `MinStep`, `MaxStep`, `CollectStep`, `GroupByStep` with static `category = "aggregate"`, auto-registering on module load. JSON formats: `["Count", {}]`, `["Sum", { property?, variable? }]`, `["Avg", { property?, variable? }]`, `["Min", { property?, variable? }]`, `["Max", { property?, variable? }]`, `["Collect", { variable? }]`, `["GroupBy", { groupByItems, returnItems }]`.

### [control/](./control/)

Control flow steps extending base implementations with registry integration. Exports `RangeStep`, `OrderStep`, `OptionalMatchStep`, `WithStep`, `UnwindStep`, `ForeachStep` with static `category = "control"`. `fromJSON` validates tuple formats: `["Range", { start: number, end: number }]`, `["Order", { directions: [...] }]`, `["OptionalMatch", { variables: string[] }, [...nestedSteps]]`, `["With", { distinct: boolean, items: [...] }]`, `["Unwind", { expression: {...}, alias: string }]`, `["Foreach", { variable: string, listExpression?, stepLabels? }, [...nestedSteps]]`. `fromAST` returns `null` (unimplemented). `clone` merges partial config with array spreading for `stepLabels`. Auto-registers with `stepRegistry` on module load.

### [fetch/](./fetch/)

Registry-enabled fetch steps extending base implementations. Exports `FetchVerticesStep`, `FetchEdgesStep`, `CartesianFetchStep` with static `category = "fetch"`. `fromJSON` validates: `["FetchVertices", { vertexLabels?: string[], ids?: string[] }]`, `["FetchEdges", { edgeLabels?: string[], ids?: string[] }]`, `["CartesianFetch", { vertexLabels?: string[], condition?: Condition, stepLabels?: string[] }]`. `fromJSON` returns `null` for null input, wrong names, or missing required fields. `fromAST` returns `null`. `clone` copies arrays via spread (`...vertexLabels`, `...ids`, `...stepLabels`). Auto-registers on module load.

### [filter/](./filter/)

Element filtering steps. Exports `FilterElementsStep`, `FilterPredicateStep`, `DedupStep` with static `category = "filter"`. `FilterPredicateStep.fromJSON` always returns `null` (function predicates non-serializable). JSON formats: `["FilterElements", { condition: Condition }]`, `["Dedup", {}]`.

### [mutation/](./mutation/)

Concrete mutation step implementations extending base classes. Exports `CreateStep`, `SetStep`, `DeleteStep`, `RemoveStep`, `MergeStep` with static `category = "mutation"`. `fromJSON` validates: `["Create", { vertices: [...], edges?: [...] }]`, `["Set", { assignments: [...] }]`, `["Delete", { variables: string[], detach?: boolean }]`, `["Remove", { items: [...] }]`, `["Merge", { pattern: {...}, onCreate?: [...], onMatch?: [...] }]`. Returns `null` for null input, non-array, length < 2, name mismatch, or missing required fields (`vertices`, `variables`, `assignments`, `items`, `pattern`). `clone` merges partial config. Auto-registers on module load.

### [setops/](./setops/)

Set operation steps extending base classes. Exports `UnionStep`, `IntersectStep`, `QueryUnionStep`, `MultiQueryStep` with static `category = "setops"`. JSON formats: `["Union", {}, [...nestedSteps]]` (returns empty steps; nested deserialization TODO), `["Intersect", {}, [...nestedSteps]]`, `["QueryUnion"|"QueryUnionAll", { all: boolean }, ...branches]`, `["MultiQuery", {}, [...statements]]` (returns empty statements; recursive deserialization TODO). `fromAST` returns `null`. Auto-registers on module load.

### [transform/](./transform/)

Element transformation steps. Exports `MapElementsStep`, `ValuesStep`, `PropertyValuesStep`, `LabelsStep`, `SelectStep`, `UnfoldStep`, `BindPathStep`, `CallStep`, `ExpressionReturnStep` with static `category = "transform"`. `MapElementsStep.fromJSON` returns `null` (function mapper prevents serialization). JSON formats: `["Values", {}]`, `["Select", { pathLabels: string[] }]`, `["Labels", { returnAsString?: boolean }]`, `["BindPath", { pathVariable: string }]`, `["Call", { procedureName: string, arguments: [...], yieldItems? }]`, `["ExpressionReturn", { items: [...] }]`.

JSON formats: `["Vertex", { direction: "in"|"out"|"both", edgeLabels?: string[], stepLabels?: string[] }]`, `["Edge", { direction, edgeLabels?: string[], stepLabels?: string[] }]`, `["Repeat", { times?, untilSteps?, emit?, emitStart?, emitInput?, stepLabels? }, [...nestedSteps]]` (validates `Array.isArray`), `["ShortestPath", { targetId?, direction?, edgeLabels?, maxDepth?, weightProperty?, stepLabels?, targetCondition? }]`. `fromAST` returns `null`. `clone` merges partial config via spread. ## Architecture

### Wrapper + Registration Pattern

Each step file extends a base implementation from `../../Steps.js` (e.g., `BaseCountStep`) and adds static metadata (`stepName`, `category`) plus factory methods. Module-level `stepRegistry.register({ name, category, constructor })` executes at load time, establishing bidirectional lookup: name → constructor for deserialization, constructor → metadata for serialization.

### JSON Serialization Pipeline

Steps serialize to `[stepName: string, config: object, nestedSteps?: Step[]]` tuples. `StepRegistry.fromJSON` validates the tuple format, extracts the name, looks up the `StepDefinition`, and delegates to `StepConstructor.fromJSON` for instantiation. `fromJSON` returns `null` rather than throwing on validation failure, enabling safe deserialization chains.

### Base Class Extension Chain

All steps extend base classes imported from `../../Steps.js`. Execution logic remains in base classes; wrapper files provide only registry integration, JSON deserialization, and cloning. Examples: `CountStep extends BaseCountStep`, `VertexStep extends BaseVertexStep`, `RepeatStep extends BaseRepeatStep`.

## Patterns

### Registry Auto-Registration

Side effect on module load: `stepRegistry.register({ name: Class.stepName, category: Class.category, constructor: Class })`. Importing any step file mutates global `stepRegistry` state immediately, enabling factory instantiation via `stepRegistry.create(name, config)`.

### JSON Factory Validation

Static `fromJSON(json: unknown): Step | null` implements runtime type validation via array length checks (`json.length >= 2`), element indexing (`json[0] === stepName`), and config field presence verification. Returns `null` for `null` input, non-array input, name mismatch, or missing required fields.

### Clone with Partial Merge

`clone(partial?: Partial<Config>): Step` creates new instances with config object spread `{ ...this.config, ...partial }`, ensuring immutable update semantics. Nested steps arrays cloned via `.map((step) => step.clone())`. Preserves `stepLabels` via `[...config.stepLabels]` spread.

### AST Conversion Stubs

All steps implement `fromAST(_astNode: AST, _context: ASTConversionContext): Step | null` returning `null` unconditionally. Pattern-based AST conversion delegated to `astToSteps.ts` at higher level.

### Barrel Re-export Convention

Each subdirectory exports an `index.ts` aggregating all public symbols. Parent `index.ts` re-exports from all subdirectories plus base classes from `Steps.js`.

## Behavioral Contracts

### StepCategory Taxonomy

Union type: `"fetch" | "traversal" | "filter" | "transform" | "aggregate" | "mutation" | "control" | "setops" | "other"`.

### Registry Error Messages

- Duplicate registration: `'Step "${name}" is already registered'`
- Unknown step instantiation: `"Unknown step: ${name}"`

### JSON Tuple Formats by Category

**fetch**: `["FetchVertices", { vertexLabels?: string[], ids?: string[], stepLabels?: string[] }]`, `["FetchEdges", { edgeLabels?: string[], ids?: string[], stepLabels?: string[] }]`, `["CartesianFetch", { vertexLabels?: string[], condition?: Condition, stepLabels?: string[] }]`

**traversal**: `["Vertex", { direction: "in"|"out"|"both", edgeLabels?: string[], stepLabels?: string[] }]`, `["Edge", { direction, edgeLabels?: string[], stepLabels?: string[] }]`, `["Repeat", { times?, untilSteps?, emit?, emitStart?, emitInput?, stepLabels? }, [...nestedSteps]]`, `["ShortestPath", { targetId?: string, maxDepth?: number, weightProperty?: string, targetCondition?: Condition, stepLabels?: string[] }]`

**filter**: `["FilterElements", { condition: Condition, stepLabels?: string[] }]`, `["Dedup", { stepLabels?: string[] }]`

**transform**: `["Values", { stepLabels?: string[] }]`, `["Select", { pathLabels: string[], stepLabels?: string[] }]`, `["Labels", { returnAsString?: boolean, stepLabels?: string[] }]`, `["BindPath", { pathVariable: string, stepLabels?: string[] }]`, `["Call", { procedureName: string, arguments: [...], yieldItems?, stepLabels?: string[] }]`, `["ExpressionReturn", { items: [...], stepLabels?: string[] }]`

**aggregate**: `["Count", {}]`, `["Sum", { property?: string, variable?: string, stepLabels?: string[] }]`, `["Avg", { property?: string, variable?: string, stepLabels?: string[] }]`, `["Min", { property?: string, variable?: string, stepLabels?: string[] }]`, `["Max", { property?: string, variable?: string, stepLabels?: string[] }]`, `["Collect", { variable?: string, stepLabels?: string[] }]`, `["GroupBy", { groupByItems: [...], returnItems: [...], stepLabels?: string[] }]`

**mutation**: `["Create", { vertices: [...], edges?: [...], stepLabels?: string[] }]`, `["Set", { assignments: [...], stepLabels?: string[] }]`, `["Delete", { variables: string[], detach?: boolean, stepLabels?: string[] }]`, `["Remove", { items: [...], stepLabels?: string[] }]`, `["Merge", { pattern: {...}, onCreate?: [...], onMatch?: [...], stepLabels?: string[] }]`

**control**: `["Range", { start: number, end: number, stepLabels?: string[] }]`, `["Order", { directions: [...], stepLabels?: string[] }]`, `["OptionalMatch", { variables: string[], stepLabels?: string[] }, [...nestedSteps]]`, `["With", { distinct: boolean, items: [...], orderBy?, skip?, limit?, whereCondition?, stepLabels?: string[] }]`, `["Unwind", { expression: {...}, alias: string, stepLabels?: string[] }]`, `["Foreach", { variable: string, listExpression?, stepLabels?: string[] }, [...nestedSteps]]`

**setops**: `["Union", { stepLabels?: string[] }, [...nestedSteps]]` (returns empty steps; nested deserialization TODO), `["Intersect", { stepLabels?: string[] }, [...nestedSteps]]`, `["QueryUnion"|"QueryUnionAll", { all: boolean, stepLabels?: string[] }, ...branches]`, `["MultiQuery", { stepLabels?: string[] }, [...statements]]` (returns empty statements; recursive deserialization TODO)

### Null Return Conditions for fromJSON

Returns `null` when: input is `null`, input is not an array, array length < 2, `json[0]` does not match `stepName`, or required config fields missing (`vertices`, `variables`, `assignments`, `items`, `condition`, `direction`, etc.).

### Non-Serializable Steps

`FilterPredicateStep.fromJSON` and `MapElementsStep.fromJSON` always return `null` (function predicates/mappers prevent JSON serialization).

### Condition Tuple Formats (from conditions.ts)

- Binary: `["=", string, string]`, `["!=", string, string]`, `["<", string, string]`, `[">", string, string]`, `["=~", string, regex]`, `["startsWith", string, prefix]`, `["contains", string, substring]`
- Logical: `["and", ...conds]`, `["or", ...conds]`, `["not", cond]`, `["xor", cond1, cond2]`
- Unary: `["exists", string]`, `["isNull", string]`, `["isNotNull", string]`
- Collection: `["in", string, [...values]]`
- Expression: `["expr", operator, leftOperand, rightOperand]`

### Value Reference Types

- Parameter: `{"type": "parameterRef", "name": string}` → `context.params[name]`
- Property: `{"type": "propertyRef", "variable": string, "property": string}` → `vertex.get(property)`
- Variable: `{"type": "variableRef", "variable": string}` → `Vertex` instance
- Arithmetic: `{"type": "arithmeticExpression", "operator": "+"|"-"|"*"|"/"|"%"|"^", "left": ..., "right": ...}`
- List literal: `{"type": "listLiteral", "values": [...]}`
- Map literal: `{"type": "mapLiteral", "entries": [{key, value}]}`
